rules.eligibility: NEW one perceived living physical creature within120ft/LoE. Actual current normalHP must be strictly<100 at application; temporaryHP never enters the threshold. Living dying0 qualifies; already dead/nonliving HP-only animation does not. This is an explicit living target completion, not an inferred universal Necromancy immunity. Known impossible target rejects before pay; hidden100+, hidden nonliving identity or changed eligibility spends a lawful commitment without numeric disclosure, no retarget. Eligible target makes one binary CON save against actual caster DC; success prevents both death and rising.
rules.death: On failure and after actual applicable defenses, resolve a nondamage would-die event. No necrotic damage, damage root, Wound save, zero-HP damage threshold or death-save failure is fabricated. TemporaryHP, resistances, caster Null Veil damage nonlethality and ordinary Death Ward positive-to-zero floor do not themselves prevent this event. A real applicable would-die replacement (e.g. actually acquired Cleric16 Ritual of Undeath Ward, already paid and active) can prevent death; then no rising. Finish actual death and its sourced triggers/claims before attempting body allocation.
rules.rising: NEW physical Ghoul-derived animation, explicitly not a same-person undead resurrection. Only this spell’s actual completed death can supply its same usable body. If a prior actual death-trigger return such as Clone succeeds for this death, cancel this spell’s rising even if old remains still exist; do not create a simultaneous living original and newly animated old body from this event. Otherwise require connected usable actual body/anatomy and unclaimed matter. Missing/destroyed/disintegrated/already allocated body blocks rising without rewinding death or selecting another corpse. Unknown physical premises hold the rising branch. The local adaptation permits actual Tiny through Large creature bodies rather than importing Create Undead’s Small/Medium Humanoid gate; fixed stats do not guess a creature CR or restore missing parts.

rules.statisticsJustification: NEW choose only the accepted Ghoul comparison’s fixed40HP/13AC/six scores/movement/attack/rider, never the strongest four-profile result. NEW snapshot original caster attack/DC/PB at creation instead of that comparison’s continuing caster-stat dependency, so permanent independent body needs no dead creator lookup. Copy exact numbers into the new actor. Original person remains dead; memories, personality, classes, magical training, resources, ownership and soul are not transferred. Unrated mechanical Undead is not a cosmological soul assertion.
rules.agency: NEW no automatic caster control, loyalty, hostility, work order, wages or companion command allowance. Independent actor has no turn in creation round; first independent opportunity is the next numbered round at a fixed virtual slot immediately after the original caster’s captured regular slot, then once each numbered round, regardless of creator initiative change/death. It receives ordinary Action/movement/Bonus Action/Reaction only when a source grants usable actions; no Extra Attack or special reaction. Actual goals/content/needs must be supplied before campaign use, otherwise the agency-dependent branch is held. Explicit fixture goal is test input, not granted by the spell.
rules.persistence: Physical conversion is permanent and survives original caster loss, ordinary antimagic and link dispel. Only the slow rider is magical/nonspell and suppressible; generic spell-only dispel does not erase the physical body or a nonspell rider. Completed0structuralHP destroys the HP-only animation and leaves consumed unusable-for-new-animation remains and real gear; no Wounds/death-save or ordinary living healing engine unless another exact source grants it. No new corpse, XP, resource, harvest or resurrection-target farm follows. Actual applicable physical damage/healing/repair/needs require sources; Undead does not imply no food/air/water/sleep.
rules.nullAndReturn: NEW explicitly extend the named animation NullDisabled rule: a qualifying damage-root Nonlethal effect on this HP-only animation leaves it inert at0, not destroyed; identity-specific disabling and recovery require the actual Null source. No generic nondamage prevention follows. Future attacks use the animation as damage owner; original caster Null is not inherited. Later true resurrection is governed by its exact identity/body requirements and current claims; no body can be allocated twice. This spell gives no new personal soul binding, compelled service, CR-based command access or cosmology.
